movement.formula: adjusted movement = Visual Baseball measurement + stadium/pitch offset

validation.selection_rule: lower held-out observed-action MSE, neither swing nor take MSE worse by more than 2%; player ranks and SA correlation are not selection targets
validation.counterfactual_validation: unobserved opposite actions cannot be directly validated

period_reproducibility.interpretation: descriptive repeatability; cross-fit training overlaps, not independent prospective validation
descriptive repeatability; cross-fit training overlaps, not independent prospective validation

support_definition: training pitches for opposite action in normalized 0.5 location cell x count; under 30 flagged, not removed or score-clipped

metric_contract.za_raw: 100 * mean((S - p_swing) * (V_swing - V_take)); runs per 100 pitches
metric_contract.dv_per_100: same as za_raw; retained for backward-compatible consumers
metric_contract.swing_aggression: 100 * mean(S - p_swing); percentage points, tendency only
metric_contract.za_percentile: midrank percentile among season hitters with at least 300 eligible pitches
metric_contract.region_contributions: 100 * sum(D in region/action) / ALL eligible player pitches; additive

shrinkage: RE state -> base/out -> outs; event RV state -> event/count -> event, 50 prior pitches; InPlay regression blends toward event/state prior with n/(n+50) local InPlay support
limitations: 리그 평균 실행 능력을 기준으로 추정한 의사결정 가치이며 개인별 최적 판단의 정답이 아닙니다.
관측하지 못한 반대 행동과 누락된 투구 특성에 따른 선택 편향이 남습니다. 실제 타구속도·발사각·해당 투구의 안타/홈런은 판단 점수의 입력이 아닙니다.
시즌 표시값은 날짜 블록 교차적합으로 해당 경기 결과를 제외하지만 다른 블록의 미래 경기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 순수한 사전 예측 성능은 별도 시간 분리 평가에서 확인합니다.
